value: root length, number of lateral roots, biomass and relative shoot area significantly increased under the static magnetic field compared with sham
method: seedlings on half-strength MS medium under a static magnetic field from NdFeB N38 magnets for 7 days, compared with sham; total root length, lateral root number, fresh whole-plant biomass and relative shoot area scored; one-way ANOVA
conditions: Col-0; the effect came from one of five magnet setups screened (10 cm regular triangular prism magnet with its edge perpendicular to gravity, inhomogeneous field); thin cuboid (about 5 mT), thick cuboid (about 200 mT), 3 cm prism and 10 cm prism edge parallel to gravity gave no significant effect; 22 C, 16 h light 8 h dark; three independent experiments, n = 24 seedlings; 'all conditions' means Sham, SMF, Sham + Fe and SMF + Fe, and iron stress alone lowered root length, biomass and shoot area; field strength of the setup used later is not stated in the Methods
